thread:
Priya: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we've seen a repeating OOM pattern tied to background compaction and shard residency growth. creating a short sync thread for owners and timelines.
Liam: saw it too. allocation traces point to retained slices from compaction buffers that never drop. I captured a heap profile during a spike.
Arun: are these 64GB or 96GB machines? fragmentation behaviour differs.
Liam: mostly 64GB nodes, a few 96GB. interestingly, 96s show higher fragmentation but fewer OOMs (more headroom).
Tess: can you paste the top alloc stacks?
Liam: top frames: `compactor::merge_segment -> compactor::hold_buffer -> shard::resident_extend -> kv::write`
Priya: ok. proposed immediate actions:
  - Liam: upload pprof + heap-diff with object backtraces and annotate likely retained frames (due Tue EOD)
  - Arun: add ephemeral alert (soft) for `shard_resident_percent > 70%` with 15m window; escalate to pager at 90% (1m, repeat) (1d)
  - Tess: add small repro harness that runs compaction-heavy workload with churn; attach to nightly stress (2d)
  - infra-bot/mem-guard-bot: when alert fires, capture `/proc/*.smaps` and `pmap -x` into debug bucket automatically (immediate)
Arun: for alert thresholds, I'm suggesting warning at 70%, critical at 90%. aggregation 15m to avoid GC noise.
Tess: for the repro, I'll fork `kv-chaos` and add toggleable compaction intensity. local command: 
``
./kv-chaos --shards=512 --compaction-threads=4 --write-ratio=0.6 --delete-ratio=0.3 --duration=30m
```
Liam: I'll also produce a flamegraph for compaction threads and a delta of retained object counts pre/post compaction. will put artifacts under `s3://redwood-debug/oom-compaction/3630/`.
Priya: we should validate the slab defrag param and a new `--slab-defrag-ratio` flag (Arun take?) to try a conservative defrag pass during compaction windows. If that helps, we can expose behind a feature flag.
Arun: I'll prototype `--slab-defrag-ratio=0.1` and run the stress harness. timeline: prototype in 48h, run nightly stress for 3 nights.
Tess: also add a dashboard tile: `shard_resident_bytes / node_total_bytes` 95th over 5m and a heatmap by shard to surface hot shards.
mem-guard-bot: automated note: scheduled job `kv-compaction-smoke` will start nightly at 03:30 UTC.
Priya: can we add a short-term mitigation: when residency > 92% on node, temporarily throttle compaction concurrency to free CPU/memory for eviction work? Make it a feature-flagged operator policy.
Liam: that could help. risk: compaction backlog may grow and increase IO, but better than node OOM. agree feature-flag first.
Arun: I'll add unit tests for compactor buffer release and an integration test that inserts many small keys then compacts; ensure buffers drop to zero after compaction.
Tess: owners and dates: pprof + flamegraph (Liam, Tue EOD), soft-alert live (Arun, Wed morning), repro + stress (Tess, Thu), slab-defrag prototype (Arun, 48h), dashboard + heatmap (Tess, Wed), feature-flag mitigation PR (Priya, next Mon). retrospective check 1 week post-deploy to review recurrence.
Priya: infra-bot note: please ensure nightly stress job attaches reproducible logs and a permalink to S3 artifacts.
infra-bot: acknowledged. job `kv-compaction-smoke` will attach artifacts automatically.
Liam: quick add 1: I'll try reducing compaction batch size as a quick experiment in canary branch `canary/compaction-batch-small` and report memory delta.
Tess: +1. once we have a green thermal test, we'll run canary on 10% of nodes for 24h.
Priya: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem action table and mark owners. ping here when any step completes and we'll close the loop. :white_check_mark:
